summary: Progress bar with an optional label and value. Follows a value you push, or runs on its own for a duration.

placements.doc: Bar codes the layout has: t top of the screen, c under the crosshair, b above the HUD (ProgressLayout.Placements).

panels.doc: The bar. Author it with class `hidden`.
Label above the bar, left. `empty` when blank.
Label above the bar, right. `empty` when blank.
The fill, drawn with `clip`. `step-N` is the pushed value (N of ProgressLayout.Steps). `timed` runs on its own: `dur-N` is the seconds, `up` fills instead of draining, `run` starts it.

texts.doc: ProgressOptions.ValueText, or the percentage under ShowPercent
